_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Tape is a documented coil with flat 30d momentum and no range break; base rate favors HOLD until a breaker prints.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst forward is HOLD/coil; narrative is descriptive flows only, no forward phase call
next_move.confirmed_if: F&G stays 45-62, 30d momentum near flat, BTC holds the recent range
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks the range and momentum leaves 45-60, especially downside while exchange netflow and skew stay elevated
